scenes.caption: Two countries.
scenes.say: Fatima puts two maps side by side. One is Pakistan and one is the UK.

scenes.caption: Provinces.
scenes.say: Pakistan has four provinces, and Islamabad is the capital.

scenes.caption: Nations.
scenes.say: The UK has four nations, and London is the capital.

scenes.caption: Mountains.
scenes.say: K2 in Pakistan is far taller than Ben Nevis in Scotland.

scenes.caption: Time.
scenes.say: When it is noon in London, it is later in Lahore.

scenes.caption: Coasts.
scenes.say: The UK is smaller, but its winding coast is longer.

scenes.caption: Links.
scenes.say: Many families link the two countries through the Commonwealth.

scenes.caption: Alike and different.
scenes.say: Fatima sees that two countries can be alike and different.
